_rule: PROPER NOUNS ONLY — people, places, artists, institutions (04-laws.md §9). The v6-4 runtime whitelist violated this rule; it is not inherited.
_flaggedTokensRule: Known-unlawful Kreyòl tokens named in 04-laws.md §9 — not proper nouns, not in scope, carrying no diacritic tell, so the wordlist rules cannot catch them. Explicitly flagged until resolved by scope-add or rename (Manman gate). Removing an entry requires the resolution to be recorded in 04-laws.md.
_ambiguousTokensRule: Recorded amendment (04-laws.md §9, 2026-07-10): scope ids that are also common English words are exempt from per-token flagging in English chrome — they flag only when diacritic-bearing or matched as whole Kreyòl phrases. This list is declared openly here (the v6-4 lint hid an equivalent list in code, which the trap review forbade inheriting undeclared).
